title: PennantPark Secures $1.9 Billion Across Senior Credit Funds, Highlighting Strong Investor Demand for Core Middle Market Lending
summary: MIAMI, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) –– PennantPark Investment Advisers, LLC (“PennantPark”) today announced the final closing of PennantPark Senior Credit Fund II (“PSCF II”), which exceeded its original target with $1.2 billion of investable capital. The post PennantPark Secures $1.9 Billion Across Senior Credit Funds, Highlighting Strong Investor Demand for Core Middle Market Lending appeared first on PennantPark .
